transaction_dt_semantics.description: Continuous timedelta from an undisclosed reference datetime. Minimum value is 86400 (Day 1).
transaction_dt_semantics.monotonicity_requirement: Strict ascending order required for temporal splits to avoid future leakage.

missing_value_structure.v_feature_sparsity_blocks: V-features (V1-V339) are partitioned into co-missingness blocks based on the payment card provider, merchant system, and checkout protocol. Filling missing values with a uniform constant (-999 or median) without preserving block structure induces spurious correlations.

excluded_due_to_future_information_or_se.reason: Chargebacks arrive 30-90 days after transaction settlement. Cannot be used as an input feature or real-time label.
Target encoding computed over the entire dataset leaks future fraud labels into historical training features.
Card velocity features computed using centered or forward-looking time windows leak future transactions into the past.

entity_duplication_and_retry_audit.mechanism: High-frequency card-testing bursts create multiple transactions with identical card1/amount within small delta-t (<60s).
entity_duplication_and_retry_audit.treatment: Grouped or time-windowed deduplication must not cross temporal validation folds.

quantum_subsampling_feature_reduction_sp.reduction_method: Top mutual information / permutation importance features strictly from training split (TransactionAmt, card1, C1, C13, D1, D15, V258, V307)
quantum_subsampling_feature_reduction_sp.scaling: StandardScaler fit strictly on training fold.
